title: My match with friends
text: My name is Leo and I am twelve years old. My favorite game on Roblox is BEAR (Alpha). On Saturdays I play with my friends Lucas and Marta.
Last Saturday a new match started. The game chose the Bear at random... and it was Marta! Lucas and I were survivors. We had to survive until the end of the time.
First, I was running down a long, dark hallway when I heard footsteps behind me. How scary! I went into a bedroom and hid under a bed. Lucas was hiding inside a wardrobe, next to the door.
While I was lying under the bed, the Bear came into the room. My heart was beating very fast. Marta was looking everywhere, but she did not see us. After a few seconds, she left the room. Phew!
In the end, the time finished and Lucas and I won. We got quidz, the money of the game. With quidz you can buy new skins for your character.
My advice: do not always hide in the same place, listen carefully to the footsteps and help your friends. And if you are the Bear, look inside the wardrobes!
q: When does Leo play with his friends?
What was Leo doing when he heard footsteps?
He was running down a hallway
What is one piece of advice from Leo?
Always hide in the same place

grammar.title: Grammar: the past continuous
grammar.rule: Use the past continuous (was / were + -ing) for an action in progress in the past. Use the past simple for a short action that interrupts it.
rows: I was running when I heard...
items: I ___ running when I heard footsteps.
Marta was looking everywhere when the time ___.
They ___ footsteps while they were hiding.

es.title: Mi partida con amigos
es.grammar: Gramática: el pasado continuo (was / were + -ing) para una acción que estaba en marcha en el pasado. El pasado simple, para la acción corta que la interrumpe.
